seo.analytics.body: Mā ngā tatau whārangi me ngā pāwhiri App Store ka kōwhiria e āwhina te whakapai pae. Kua weto kia whakaae koe. Kāore he hopunga, taipitopito pūkete taupānga rānei. Ka noho matua ngā tohu tūmataitinga pūtirotiro.
seo.privacy.title: Tātari pae ka kōwhiria
seo.privacy.body: Kua weto te tātari pae i te tīmatanga. Ki te whakaae koe mā te hiku o te pae, ka tuku mātou ki PostHog (e manaakihia ana ki Amerika) i te kāwai whārangi, reo, kāwai whānui o te puna tuku me te tūnga pātene App Store. Ka noho tētahi tautohu matapōkere mō te whārangi o nāianei anake, kāore e herea ki tō pūkete taupānga. Kāore mātou e tuku ingoa, īmēra, kōtaha tamariki, ihirangi waea, whakaurunga puka, URL puna katoa, tawhā uiui URL rānei. Kāore tēnei tātari e whakamahi pihikete pānuitanga, whakaari anō wātū, hopu pāhekoheko aunoa rānei. He motuhake te Meta Pixel o raro, he whakahaere anō tōna. Ka whiwhi a PostHog i ngā mōhiohio whatunga ina tae te tono ki tana ratonga; kua whakawetohia te tāpiri tauwāhi me te tiaki wāhitau IP ki ngā āhuatanga takahanga i ā mātou tautuhinga. Ka tiakina tō kōwhiringa tātari ki te pūrere. Ka taea te whakamutu tatau ā muri i te hiku; kāore e muku ngā takahanga kua tae kē. Ka whakaute mātou i Global Privacy Control me Do Not Track. Kei ngā hononga App Store tētahi tapanga kaupapa pae tiritahi, ehara i te tautohu whaiaro, kia tukuna ai e Apple ngā pūrongo kaupapa i raro i tana ake kaupapahere. Whakapā mai mō ngā pātai, tono raraunga rānei.

Ka whiwhi i ngā mōhiohio tirotiro noa, te pihikete Meta me te pātene App Store i pāngia, kaua rawa ngā kōtaha tamariki, pūkete taupānga, whakaurunga puka, ihirangi waea rānei. Ki te EU, UK me Huiterangi ka weto kia whakaae koe. Mā ngā tohu tūmataitinga pūtirotiro e whakaweto.

Ina mahi, ka whiwhi Meta i ngā whārangi e tirohia ana, te pātene App Store i pāngia, ngā mōhiohio pūtirotiro me te pūrere, tō wāhitau IP me te pihikete Meta ka noho ki te 90 rā. Ka herea pea e Meta ki tō pūkete Meta i raro i tana ake kaupapahere. Kāore mātou e tuku ingoa, īmēra, kōtaha tamariki, pūkete taupānga, whakaurunga puka, ihirangi waea rānei. Kua whakawetohia te whakaōrite matatau aunoa, kohinga takahanga aunoa me te whirihoranga aunoa a Meta; kua whakakāhia Limited Data Use ki ngā wāhi e hāngai ana. Mēnā kei te EU, UK, Huiterangi rānei te rohe wā pūtirotiro, ka weto te Pixel kia kōwhiri koe i Whakaae ki te kara; ki wāhi kē ka mahi ki te kore koe e whakaweto. Ka taea te huri kōwhiringa i ngā wā katoa ki Ine pānuitanga i te hiku pae; ka whakaute mātou i Global Privacy Control me Do Not Track. Mā te whakaweto e mutu ai ngā tukunga ā muri, kāore e muku ngā mōhiohio kua tae kē ki Meta. Kāore te Pixel e mahi ki ngā whārangi utu, whakaū, ki roto rānei i te taupānga.

privacy.appanalytics.body: Ki ngā putanga taupānga whai “Āwhina ki te whakapai Dial Santa”, kua weto tēnei kōwhiringa motuhake i te tīmatanga. Ki te whakakā te matua, ka tuku tā mātou API ki PostHog (e manaakihia ana ki Amerika) i ngā hipanga taupānga kua tohua, ngā hua manatoko me te tīmatanga, reo, kiripuaki, kāwai puna, ngā hua tūhono waea, ngā kōwhiringa urupare ka kōwhiria, me ngā nui utu hoko, whakahoki rānei, ngā hua me ngā moni kua manatokona. Mā ngā tautohu matapōkere taupānga me te pūkete mātua e here ngā takahanga puta noa i ngā wātū me ngā pūrere takiuru. He tautohu ingoa kē ēnei, ehara i te ingoakore: ka taea e tā mātou ratonga te here i te ID matua ki te pūkete. Kāore te ine pae e herea. Kāore mātou e tuku ingoa, īmēra, kōtaha tamariki, whakaurunga puka, oro waea, tuhinga kōrero, ataata, hopunga, tautohu pānuitanga rānei ki PostHog. Kāore he whakaari anō wātū, hopu pāhekoheko aunoa rānei. Kua monokia te tāpiri tauwāhi; mā tō mātou tūmau ngā takahanga e tae ai ki PostHog.

He tirohanga whaiaro ā-pūrere te kāmera, kāore e tukuna ki ngā kaiwhakarato AI, ki ō mātou tūmau rānei. Mā ngā kaiwhakarato te oro waea me ngā taipitopito e tukatuka e ai ki te kaupapahere tūmataitinga. Kaua e homai wāhitau, ingoa kura, ētahi atu kōrero rānei kāore koe e hiahia kia tukatukatia.
guide.facetime-santa.body.14: Whakaritea he pātai kotahi: “He aha ngā kai a ngā renitia?” he māmā ake i te rārangi roa. Kia mārie te rūma, noho ki te taha o te tamaiti, tukua kia whai wā. Ka pārekareka tētahi mihi poto ki te tamaiti e hiahia ana ki te whakarongo anake; kaua e akiaki kia whakaari.
guide.facetime-santa.body.15: Whakamātauria ā mātou pātai ki a Hana Kōkō, pānuihia rānei te aratohu mātua i mua i te waea.
guide.facetime-santa.body.16: He tohu hokohoko a FaceTime nō Apple Inc. He taupānga motuhake a Dial Santa, kāore e hono ana ki Apple, kāore hoki a Apple i whakamana.
guide.how-to-call-santa.title: Me Pēhea te Waea ki a Hana Kōkō i te iPhone: Whakarite, Utu me ngā Tohutohu | Dial Santa
guide.how-to-call-santa.description: He aratohu whaihua ki te waea Hana Kōkō mā Dial Santa: whakarite mātua, whakaritenga iPhone, mōkihi meneti, tūmataitinga me ngā tohutohu mō tō waea AI ora tuatahi.
guide.how-to-call-santa.heading: Me pēhea te waea ki a Hana Kōkō i tō iPhone
guide.how-to-call-santa.intro: He kokonga mārie, he pātai pai kotahi, he pakeke ki te taha. Anei te whakarite mō te kōrerorero AI Hana Kōkō ora tuatahi a tō whānau mā Dial Santa.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.1: He rerekē ngā wheako o te raina waea Hana Kōkō, te karere kua hopukina, te wā tāpui ki te tangata kaiwhakaari, me te waea ataata AI ora. He kōrerorero AI ora a Dial Santa: ka kōrero te tamaiti, ka whakautu tonu te kiripuaki. Kei roto i te taupānga iPhone, ehara i te waea tau waea, i te whakamahi Apple FaceTime rānei.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.3:
• He iPhone whai iOS 17, he putanga hou ake rānei, me te hononga ipurangi pai.
  • He matua, kaitiaki rānei hei hanga pūkete, kōwhiri hoko, noho hoki ki te tamaiti.
  • He uru ki te īmēra mātua mō te manatoko takiuru.
  • Ngā meneti waea kua hokona me te whakaaetanga hopuoro.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.5: Whakamahia te whārangi mana Dial Santa i te App Store. He koreutu te tiki. Me hoko meneti ngā waea i roto i te taupānga mā Apple. Kāore te tiki anake e tīmata ohaurunga.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.7: Whāia ngā hipanga manatoko īmēra i te taupānga, pānuihia ngā tikanga me te kaupapahere tūmataitinga whai hononga. Mā te matua te whakarite. Ka tiaki te ārai mātua i ngā hoko me ngā tautuhinga, engari kāore e whakakapi i te tirotiro pakeke i te kōrerorero.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.9: Whakauruhia te ingoa tuatahi. Ka taea hoki he wawata, he mahi pai rānei, pēnei i te āwhina tuakana, teina rānei, te ako mea hou rānei. Kāore e hiahiatia he tuhinga whakaari. Homai anake ngā taipitopito e pai ana kia tukatukatia mō te waea; kaua he wāhitau kāinga, ingoa kura, mōhiohio whānau tairongo rānei.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.10: 4. Kōwhiria ngā meneti me te kiripuaki
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.11: Ko ngā mōkihi o Amerika he 5 meneti mō US$2.99, 12 mō US$5.99, 30 mō US$15.99. Ka rerekē pea ngā utu App Store ā-rohe. Kāore ngā meneti e pau i te hipanga o te wā, kāore he ohaurunga. Kua whakaurua a Hana Kōkō; me wewete motuhake tana Wahine me Comet, he US$0.99 ia tangata ki Amerika, me hoko meneti waea hoki.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.12: Ka roa ngā waea Hana Kōkō me tana Wahine ki te ono meneti ia waea, a Comet ki te toru. Ka poto ake pea nā tō toenga. Ka inea ngā meneti ia hēkona tūhono, nō reira ka noho te wā kāore i whakamahia ki tō pūkete.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.14: Kimihia he wāhi mārie, whakapikihia te oro, whakaaetia te hopuoro ina tonoa. Kōwhiria te kiripuaki, tīmatahia te waea. Ka rongo, ka whakautu a Hana Kōkō ki te reo. Mā te tirohanga kāmera e kite ai tō whānau i a rātou anō ki te pūrere; kāore e tukuna ki ō mātou tūmau, ki ngā kaiwhakarato AI rānei.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.15: Tīmata mā te mihi māmā. Ki te noho puku te tamaiti, āwhinatia mā “Kei te whakaaro mātou me pēhea ngā renitia e whakarite ai mō Kirihimete.” Whāia te tere o te tamaiti, whakamutua te waea ina hiahia.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.16: I mua i te hoko mōkihi nui ake
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.17: Whakamātauria he kōrerorero poto i te tuatahi kia aromatawai ai i te wheako mō tō whānau. He rerekē ngā reo waea i ia kiripuaki, i ia putanga taupānga kua tāutatia. Tirohia te kaikōwhiri reo i te taupānga i mua i te hoko meneti.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.18: Ki te kore te waea e tūhono
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.19:
• Tirohia te ipurangi me te whakaaetanga hopuoro taupānga i ngā Tautuhinga iPhone.
  • Whakaū kei reira ngā meneti, kua wetekina hoki te kiripuaki.
  • Ki te kore koe e rongo, tirohia te taumata oro me te pūrere oro e whakamahia ana e te iPhone.
  • Ki te haere tonu te raru, whakamahia te tautoko Dial Santa. Whakaahuatia te raru me te wā tata, kaua e tuku hopunga tamariki, waehere takiuru rānei.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.21: He kōwhiringa te hopu, kua weto i te tīmatanga. Ki ngā waea e tautokona ana, ka taea te hopu ā-pūrere me te kōwhiri tiaki ki Photos. He motuhake te tukatuka oro me ngā tuhinga kōrero a ngā kaiwhakarato i taua hopunga. Pānuihia te kaupapahere tūmataitinga mō ngā kaiwhiwhi, te pupuri me ngā here muku.
guide.how-to-call-santa.body.22: Mō ngā whakaaro kōrerorero, tirohia ngā pātai ki a Hana Kōkō. Kei te whakaaro mō FaceTime? Mā tā mātou whakataurite waea ataata Hana Kōkō e whakamārama.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.title: 24 Pātai ki a Hana Kōkō i te Waea Ataata | Dial Santa
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.description: Āwhinatia tō tamaiti kia kōrero ki a Hana Kōkō mā ngā pātai pārekareka 24 mō ngā renitia, Te Pou Raki me Kirihimete, me ngā tohutohu mō ngā kaiwaea whakamā tuatahi.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.heading: 24 pātai ki a Hana Kōkō
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.intro: Ko te pātai pai rawa ko tā tō tamaiti e hiahia ana kia mōhio. Kia tata ētahi o ēnei ina titiro ia ki a Hana Kōkō, ka wareware i ngā mea i hiahia ia ki te kōrero.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.1:
1. He aha āu mahi i tēnei rā?
  2. He aha tō pihikete tino pai?
  3. Kei te hukarere ki Te Pou Raki?
  4. He aha ka whakakata i a koe?
  5. He waiata Kirihimete tino pai tāu?
  6. Ka aha koe ina hiahia whakatā?
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.3:
1. He aha te parakuihi a ngā renitia?
  2. Me pēhea ngā renitia e whakaharatau ai ki te rere?
  3. Ko tēhea renitia e pai ana ki te tākaro?
  4. Ka tau te hukarere ki ngā ihu renitia?
  5. Me pēhea e whakamahana ai i ngā renitia?
  6. Ka aha ina tihe tētahi renitia?
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.4: Mō te tirotiro i Te Pou Raki
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.5:
1. He aha ngā oro o te whare mahi?
  2. Ka aha ngā elf i ō rātou rā whakatā?
  3. Mā wai e āwhina ki te tirotiro i te reti hukarere?
  4. He tohutaka tino pai tā te Wahine a Hana Kōkō?
  5. He aha te mea tino whakakata i puta ki te whare mahi?
  6. Ki te toro au ki Te Pou Raki, he aha tāu ka whakaatu tuatahi?
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.6: Mō ngā wawata, te atawhai me te whakaaro pohewa
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.7:
1. He aha tētahi mahi atawhai ka taea e au mō tētahi i tēnei wiki?
  2. Ka taea e au te kōrero mō tētahi mea kua akona?
  3. Kei te hiahia koe ki te rongo mō taku tikanga Kirihimete tino pai?
  4. Me pēhea te kōwhiri koha mā tētahi e arohaina ana?
  5. He aha ka kuhuna e koe ki te pouaka tina a te tangata hukarere?
  6. He aha tā mātou ki ngā renitia i mua i tō haere?
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.9: Tukua kia whakarongo i te tuatahi. Ka taea te pātai tahi i te pātai tuatahi, te tuku rānei mā tētahi taonga tākaro e “pātai”. Hoatu he wāhi kia kōwhiri mēnā ka kōrero. He mihi poto, mārie e ranea ana; kāore e hiahiatia ngā pātai katoa, te wā tino tika rānei.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.10: Whāia te whakautu, kaua ko te rārangi
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.11: Kōwhiria tētahi, ētahi pātai tino pai e rua rānei. Ki te kōrero a Hana Kōkō mō te pihikete, he pātai pai o muri “Mā wai e āwhina ki te tunu?” Waiho he wā iti i muri i ia whakautu. He pārekareka ake pea te kōrero mō tētahi taipitopito renitia nui i te tere ki te whakaoti pātai rua tekau mā whā.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.13: Ka taea te rārangi wawata hei wāhanga pūrākau, kaua hei oati. Āwhinatia ngā tamariki kia kōrero mō ngā mea e pai ana, ngā tāngata e arohaina ana me ngā mea kua akona. I Dial Santa, kua tohutohutia te kiripuaki AI kia kaua e oati koha motuhake. Me noho te pakeke ki te taha nā te mea ka hē pea ngā whakautu AI.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.15: He taupānga iPhone a Dial Santa mō te kōrerorero ora tauutuutu ki tētahi Hana Kōkō AI. Mā te matua te kōtaha e whakarite me ngā meneti e hoko. He koreutu te tiki; ka tīmata ngā mōkihi Amerika i US$2.99 mō te rima meneti, kāore he ohaurunga. Ka whakautu a Hana Kōkō ki te reo, he tirohanga whaiaro ā-pūrere te kāmera.
guide.questions-to-ask-santa.body.16: Pānuihia me pēhea te waea ki a Hana Kōkō mō te whakarite, ngā whakaritenga pūrere me ngā utu, toro rānei ki te aratohu mātua. Mō te oro waea, tirohia tā mātou kaupapahere tūmataitinga.

guide.press.body.6: Ngā toi me te arokite kua whakaaetia
guide.press.body.7:

  • Toi whakatairanga Dial Santa (PNG)
  • Arokite wheako taupānga 20 hēkona (MP4)

guide.press.body.8: Whakamahia ēnei rawa i ngā kōrero mō Dial Santa. Kaua e kī kua whakamanatia e Apple, kaua hoki e whakaatu ngā kaiwaea hanga hei kiritaki tūturu. Puritia tēnei whakamōhio ki ngā ataata whakaaturanga: He whakaaturanga wheako taupānga nā AI i hanga — kāore he tamariki tūturu e whakaaturia ana.
guide.press.body.10: Mō ngā pātai hua, pāpāho rānei: hohoho@dialsanta.app. Kāore mātou i homai kōrero taunaki kiritaki, kerēme whakamahinga rānei mō tēnei whārangi.
guide.press.body.11: Tirohia ngā kōwhiringa waea ataata Hana Kōkō, te aratohu whakarite me ngā mōhiohio mātua.
